pages.text: Pound Cake can be made by compacting "1 pound" of Eggs, Dough, Sugar, Cream, and Almond Extract.$(br)Quick sidenote, the measurements are probably not exact, so don't take the recipe too seriously.
The Glass of Royal Cider item can be placed down as a decorative item while sneaking. While it just be instantly broken, you can also shift+right-click to pick it back up.
